tools.name: get_shipment
tools.title: Get shipment
tools.description: Look up a shipment's status, route, estimated delivery date and latest event by tracking number.

tracking_no.description: Shipment tracking number: KRV followed by 8 digits, e.g. KRV12345678

tools.name: reschedule_delivery
tools.title: Reschedule delivery
tools.description: Move a shipment's delivery to a new date. Needs the last four digits of the recipient's phone as verification. The date must be between tomorrow and 14 days ahead; delivered, returned or out-for-delivery shipments cannot be rescheduled.

tracking_no.description: Shipment tracking number: KRV followed by 8 digits, e.g. KRV12345678

verification_code.description: Last four digits of the recipient's phone number

reason.description: Why the customer wants a new date

tools.name: open_ticket
tools.title: Open support ticket
tools.description: Open a customer support ticket, optionally about a shipment (damaged, lost, delayed, or other).

tracking_no.description: Shipment tracking number: KRV followed by 8 digits, e.g. KRV12345678

description.description: What happened, in the customer's words

tools.name: search_help
tools.title: Search help articles
tools.description: Search the Kervan knowledge base and return the three best-matching help articles.

query.description: What the customer wants to know
